definitions.name: bs721_royalties_msg_ContributorMsg
definitions.description: Represents a contributor to the collection.

shares.description: Amount of share associated to the contributor.

distribute.description:
Update contributors withdrawable amount by computing each contributors percentage of the
total distributable contract balance. This function will consider only coins of the stored denom.

withdraw.description: Withdraw accrued royalties. This message can only be sent by a contributor.

distributable_amount.description: Retrieves amount of denom that can be distributed.

start_after.description: Address after which contributors are retrieved.

withdrawable_amount.description: Returns the total amount of royalties that can be withdrawn from the contract.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_uint128_Uint128

percentage_shares.description: Shares of the contributor in terms of percentage of total shares

withdrawable_royalties.description: Amount of royalties that can be withdrawn

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_decimal_Decimal
definitions.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 (which is (2^128 - 1) / 10^18)
